activity_summary: You read a forme of the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung. The running title was plain. A turned letter was ringed in brown ink. Your eye stopped at the soothsayer and the Ides. You copied no page. You drafted no play from it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the forme on the line, and did not start a play.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Was at the sheet. He had not yet spoken.

facets.activity: Read the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung
